author: Neema Parvini
body_text:
As we discussed in Chapter 4 in the analysis of
Gobineau, there is strong evidence that rather than
‘Christianising’ Europe, what actually took place is that
Christianity was ‘Germanised’, that is, stripped of its
original dualistic spirit and replaced with one ‘truer’
to the Faustian spirit that animates Europe. This was
Spengler’s view. For a period, roughly from the Fall
of Rome to the tenth century, Magian elements sat
uneasily side-by-side with nascent Faustian elements
in the ashes of the old Apollonian civilisation. The
